run_rejection_sampler_forward: run the RejectionSampler forward pass with draft probabilities, target logits, and sampling metadata to produce sampled token IDs
parse_rejection_sampler_output: parse the rejection sampler output by filtering placeholder tokens and returning per-request token ID lists
apply_sampling_constraints: apply temperature scaling, top-k, and top-p constraints to target logits for non-greedy sampling
generate_uniform_probs: generate uniform random probability samples for rejection sampling with optional per-request seeding
sample_recovered_tokens: sample recovered tokens from the adjusted probability distribution when draft tokens are rejected
